authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Platts p. 1095 s.v. mūṅg explicitly lists mūṅg-phalī as the groundnut Arachis hypogaea, separately from mūṅg-kī phalī the mung-bean pod. CDIAL 10198 gives Hindi mū̃g mung bean; CDIAL 9051 gives Hindi phalī pod. The whole groundnut compound therefore has two ordered Hindi lexical components, not a single mudga ancestor.
